text: Targets x86 bare-metal (no host OS underneath)
Includes a bootloader (own boot code that loads the kernel)
Includes a kernel that the bootloader transfers control to
Kernel produces text output via VGA text mode (0xB8000)
No external libraries (freestanding: no libc / third-party libs linked)
Runnable in QEMU (produces a bootable image that boots in qemu-system-i386/x86_64)
Buildable from the current directory (build script/Makefile producing the image)
Simple: system remains stable after boot (no triple fault / reboot loop)
